_comment: Based on deliverables/contracts-drafter/consent-and-privacy.md CP-v0.1 (1.2, 1.3, 1.4). v2 (Jonathan, 2026-10-05): the consent line says SortMyCover, not Lead Velocity; the privacy notice linked beside the form names the company and its address (POPIA s18). v3 (Jonathan, 2026-10-07): scope widened from 'life cover' to 'insurance and financial planning' so the consent covers every reason a client can pick (life, funeral, retirement, investments, disability, paying too much). DRAFT for practitioner review. The Meta Instant Form disclaimer text must be updated to match before W02 sends v3. {practice_name}/{fsp_number} come from site.json (brokers row).

named.text: I agree that SortMyCover may share my details with {practice_name} (FSP {fsp_number}), an authorised financial services provider, who may contact me by WhatsApp or phone about insurance and financial planning. I can opt out at any time by replying STOP.

generic.text: I agree that SortMyCover may share my details with an authorised financial services provider (FSP), who may contact me by WhatsApp or phone about insurance and financial planning. I can opt out at any time by replying STOP.

ads: We also use your details in coded (hashed) form to measure and improve our ads on Facebook and Instagram. We never use them to send you ads by message.
footer_line: SortMyCover gives no financial advice, product comparisons or premium quotes. Licensed financial advisers do.
